title: SOCIAL SCIENCE IS NECESSARY FOR OPERATIONALIZING SOCIALLY RESPONSIBLE FOUNDATION MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual evaluation discussing the systemic under-representation of women and non-binary figures in foundation model training corpora (e.g., Wikipedia) and the implications of this data gap.
Conceptual evaluation examining how technological affordances reproduce racial systems of power, citing prior case studies on harmful search engine autocompletions and skin-lightening beauty filters.
Conceptual evaluation analyzing how generative applications (like beauty filters) enforce socially-constructed attractiveness standards by artificially reducing a user's apparent weight.
